big_case.notes: The application concerned protection from removal and work authorization for hundreds of thousands of Venezuelans. The immediate question was who would keep the district court's judgment on hold during remand. Withdrawal left the Supreme Court with no new ruling on the scope of TPS review.

leakage.notes: Forward run. All ten calls have captured results. The candidate read the November 18 application and arrival record and checked the earlier matters 24A1059, 25A326 and 26-48. The log shows no lookup of the live 26A714 docket or withdrawal letter. The rationale treats withdrawal as a future contingency.
